slides.title: How to talk to your GP about perimenopause
slides.body: Four things that make a short appointment count.

slides.title: Book the right appointment
slides.body: Ask reception which GP is best to see about menopause. If you can, ask for a longer appointment.

slides.title: Bring a record
slides.body: Each symptom, how often it happens and how strong it feels. Weeks of notes say more than memory on the day.

slides.title: Say it plainly
quotes: I think this could be perimenopause.
Here's what I've noticed over the last three months.

slides.title: Know the guidance
slides.body: For women over 45 with symptoms, NICE says perimenopause can be diagnosed without blood tests. Between 40 and 45, an FSH blood test may be considered.

slides.title: Walk in with the whole picture
slides.body: Clari turns your daily notes into a GP summary you can share.
slides.source: Free on the App Store and Google Play
